blurb: The instrument rating allows you to fly by reference to instruments. Flying without visual references to the ground, or with the absence of the horizon, you’ll be free to fly most anytime, anywhere, without waiting for the weather clear out. Obstructions to visibility such as clouds, fog, and haze, can dominate the skys for days. Get the most out of your pilot certificate and fly when its convinient for you and not
